model.name: Dynamic factor model (demo)
model.description: Two-step dynamic factor model: 3 common factor(s) extracted from 68 monthly indicators by EM (statsmodels DynamicFactorMQ), averaged to quarters, and GDP y/y growth regressed on them by OLS.

caveats: Demo model from the nowcast lab; not yet a settled production choice.
Fit statistics are in-sample (cross-validated R² shown alongside); the track record is pseudo-real-time, using only data released before each GDP figure but today's revised values.
Indicator contributions use a static projection of the factors; the model's month-to-month dynamics are shown as a separate remainder.
Training sample includes the 2020-2021 COVID collapse and rebound, with no adjustment.
Intervals assume normally distributed residuals and ignore the uncertainty in estimating the factors themselves, so they are somewhat too narrow.
